## Outcome and scope

Describe the concrete correction and affected pages/files.
Classify: repository documentation / contributor checks / public copy or behavior.

## Documentation impact

- Updated guidance: links and what changed.
- If unchanged: name the guidance inspected and explain why the contract is unchanged.
- Before/after: link the diff or audit passages.

## Evidence for app or public claims

- App PR + commit SHA + latest approved decision/source:
- Live website URL + UTC observation time + public feed/source:
- Status: observed live / source-only / approved launch / blocked:
- Related FAQ, metadata, legal, llms.txt, and screenshots checked:

For changes without app/public claims, explain why this section is not applicable.

## Validation

Commands and results, affected rendered routes, and any checks that were unavailable.
Use the proportional checks in [the contributor workflow](https://github.com/jGPT-Automated/LocalCheck_WEB/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Release coordination

- Public-copy changes and outstanding app/backend/native/billing/legal prerequisites:
- Existing website PRs inspected; overlap/conflicts:
- Deployment authorization/status (including automatic previews):
- Exact next action and remaining blockers:

Do not merge, publish, deploy, write to shared Supabase, or modify the app repository
without explicit authorization for that action.
